title: Sweet Pick Up Lines: 90 Adorable Lines for Your Partner
h1: Sweet Pick Up Lines: 90 Adorable Lines for Your Girlfriend or Boyfriend
description: Sweet pick up lines for your girlfriend or boyfriend: 90 adorable, cheesy and romantic lines for texts, notes and dates, plus tips on delivering them well.
excerpt: Ninety sweet, cheesy and romantic pick up lines to make your partner smile, sorted by mood, plus tips for delivering them with charm.
intro:
Pick up lines aren't just for strangers in bars. Between partners, they're a playful way to flirt, make each other laugh and keep the spark alive long after the first date. A sweet line slipped into a text or whispered over breakfast says, "I still think you're adorable," with a wink.

Below you'll find 90 sweet pick up lines for your girlfriend or boyfriend, sorted into cute, cheesy, romantic, food-themed, nerdy, texting and good-night categories. Some will earn a laugh, some an eye-roll, and the best ones both. At the end, there are a few tips for delivering them so they land as charming rather than cringe. Pick your favorites and start sending.
body:
Cute and sweet pick up lines

  1. Are you a magician? Because whenever I look at you, everyone else disappears.
  2. Do you have a name, or can I just call you mine?
  3. Is it hot in here, or is it just you smiling at me?
  4. If you were a fruit, you'd be a fine-apple.
  5. I must be a snowflake, because I've fallen for you.
  6. Are you a camera? Because every time I look at you, I smile.
  7. Do you believe in love at first sight, or should I walk by again?
  8. You must be made of copper and tellurium, because you're Cu-Te.
  9. Is your name Wi-Fi? Because I'm feeling a strong connection.
  10. If kisses were snowflakes, I'd send you a blizzard.
  11. Are you a parking ticket? Because you've got "fine" written all over you.
  12. You're like a dictionary. You add meaning to my life.
  13. I'd say God bless you, but it looks like he already did.
  14. You must be tired, because you've been running through my mind all day.

Cheesy pick up lines that still work

  1. Are you a bank loan? Because you've got my interest.
  2. Do you have a map? I keep getting lost in your eyes.
  3. Are you a campfire? Because you're hot and I want s'more.
  4. If you were a vegetable, you'd be a cute-cumber.
  5. Are you a keyboard? Because you're just my type.
  6. Is there an airport nearby, or is that just my heart taking off?
  7. Are you French? Because Eiffel for you.
  8. Are you a broom? Because you just swept me off my feet.
  9. I'm not a photographer, but I can definitely picture us together.
  10. Do you have a Band-Aid? I scraped my knee falling for you.
  11. Are you a light switch? Because you brighten up every room you walk into.
  12. Are you a time traveler? Because I see you in my future.
  13. If you were a triangle, you'd be acute one.
  14. Is your dad a boxer? Because you're a knockout.

Romantic pick up lines

  1. I'd never play hide and seek with you, because someone like you is impossible to find.
  2. If I had a star for every time you brightened my day, I'd have a galaxy.
  3. You're the reason I look forward to tomorrow.
  4. Every love song makes sense now that I have you.
  5. I didn't believe in soulmates until I met you.
  6. You're the missing piece I didn't know I was looking for.
  7. If I could rearrange the alphabet, I'd put U and I together.
  8. Falling for you was the easiest thing I've ever done.
  9. My heart beats a little differently when you're around.
  10. You're the first thing I think about in the morning and the last at night.
  11. I'd choose you in a hundred lifetimes, in a hundred worlds.
  12. Home isn't a place anymore. It's you.
  13. If loving you is wrong, I don't want to be right.
  14. You make my heart feel like it's wearing sunshine.

Food pick up lines

  1. Are you a cupcake? Because you're too sweet to resist.
  2. You're the cheese to my macaroni.
  3. We go together like peanut butter and jelly.
  4. Are you a donut? Because I find you a-dough-rable.
  5. I love you a latte.
  6. You're one in a melon.
  7. Are you a pizza? Because I want a pizza that.
  8. You're sweeter than a stack of pancakes with extra syrup.
  9. Are you a cookie? Because I'd love to keep you in my jar forever.
  10. I think you're berry special.
  11. You must be a dessert, because I always save room for you.
  12. Lettuce be together forever.

Nerdy and clever pick up lines

  1. Are you made of oxygen? Because I need you to breathe.
  2. If you were a function, you'd be my favorite derivative of happiness.
  3. You must be the square root of -1, because you can't be real.
  4. Are you a black hole? Because I can't escape your pull.
  5. Our love is like pi: irrational and never-ending.
  6. You've got more charm than a quark.
  7. Are you a 90-degree angle? Because you're looking right.
  8. I'd like to be your Wi-Fi password, so you'd never forget me.
  9. Are you a compiler? Because you make my heart run without errors.
  10. You're the CSS to my HTML. You make everything look better.
  11. If you were a planet, you'd be the center of my universe, scientifically inaccurate but true.
  12. Our chemistry is off the periodic table.

Want more brainy options? Check out our clever pick up lines.

Sweet pick up lines to text

  1. Is your phone okay? Because it's been too long since I heard from you.
  2. My phone keeps telling me to update, but all I want is an update from you.
  3. Are you a notification? Because you always make my day light up.
  4. Did you just text me? Because my heart did a little backflip.
  5. If you were a text, I'd read you a hundred times.
  6. Quick question: is it possible to miss someone you saw an hour ago? Asking for me.
  7. You're my favorite name to see on my lock screen.
  8. I was going to send a cute emoji, but none of them are as cute as you.
  9. Roses are red, my phone's at 2%, but I'm using it to tell you you're perfect.
  10. Are you a battery? Because you recharge me every time we talk.
  11. I just checked the forecast: 100% chance of me thinking about you today.
  12. Do you have a minute? I wanted to remind you that you're amazing.

For more texting ideas, see our texts to make him miss you.

Good night pick up lines

  1. Are you a dream? Because I want to see you every time I close my eyes.
  2. Sleep tight, and don't let the thoughts of me keep you up too late.
  3. Is it bedtime already? Because I'm not done falling for you today.
  4. If you dream of me tonight, save me a seat.
  5. The stars are out, but none of them shine like you.
  6. Good night to the person who makes every day worth waking up for.
  7. I'd count sheep, but I'd rather count the reasons I love you.
  8. Close your eyes and imagine my arms around you. That's where you belong.

Bonus: extra-adorable pick up lines

  1. Are you a puppy? Because I want to cuddle you all day.
  2. You're so sweet, you're giving me a toothache.
  3. If cuteness were a crime, you'd be serving a life sentence.
  4. Do you have a sunburn, or are you always this hot?

How to use sweet pick up lines

A line is only as charming as its delivery. A few tips:

  • Lean into the cheese. Say it with a grin or follow it with "I know, I know." Owning the cheesiness is half the fun.
  • Match the moment. Save romantic lines for quiet moments and silly ones for playful moods.
  • Personalize it. Swap in their favorite food, hobby or show. A line about their beloved tacos beats a generic one.
  • Don't overdo it. One great line in a day is a treat. Ten in a row starts to feel like a routine.
  • Follow with sincerity. After the laugh, add something real: "Seriously though, I'm so glad you're mine."
Tip: Write a sweet pick up line on a sticky note and leave it somewhere unexpected: the bathroom mirror, their laptop, or inside their wallet. It's a tiny surprise that can brighten their whole day.

Looking for more? Browse romantic pick up lines, cheesy pickup lines for him, or our full pickup lines collection.
takeaways: Sweet pick up lines are a playful way for couples to flirt and keep the spark alive.
Choose lines that fit the mood: cute, cheesy, romantic, nerdy or good night.
Personalize lines with your partner's favorite foods, hobbies or inside jokes.
Deliver cheesy lines with a smile, then follow up with something sincere.
Use them sparingly so each one feels like a treat.

faq.q: What is a sweet pick up line?
faq.a: A sweet pick up line is a playful, affectionate compliment, often with a pun or a cheesy twist, designed to make someone smile. Between partners, they're a lighthearted way to flirt and show you still find each other adorable. Think of them as compliments with a wink.

faq.q: Do pick up lines work on your partner?
faq.a: They often work best with a partner, because there's no pressure and you share a sense of humor. Delivered with a smile and followed by a sincere compliment, a sweet line can make your partner laugh and feel appreciated. Laughter is part of the charm.

faq.q: What is the cutest pick up line?
faq.a: Favorites include "Do you have a name, or can I just call you mine?" and "I must be a snowflake, because I've fallen for you." The cutest line is usually one tailored to your partner's interests or an inside joke.

faq.q: Can I send pick up lines over text?
faq.a: Yes. Texting is a great way to share pick up lines because your partner can enjoy them at their own pace. Add a playful emoji or follow up with a sweet message to make it feel personal. It turns an ordinary moment into a sweet surprise.
